plan: Drive: from Village of Burns Lake, about 67 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Tibbets Creek Rd, Hwy 16, Hwy 35, Brown Rd.
Park: 53.71711, -125.46365, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 5.2 km NW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 384 m, about 143 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 120 m SE of the spot at 1,078 m (53.7494, -125.51894). Water: unnamed wetland 50 m W (estimate).
Hunt: moose, season: VERIFY. Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-4, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-02, closures 2026-10-16.
